regenerated.coulomb_constant_unrelated: Static energy, force and virial baselines are NOT regenerated and do not change: no Coulomb, Lennard-Jones or bonded quantity depends on k_B.
regenerated.explanation: temperature_mean moves by 1.079e-07 relative and temperature_stddev by 1.912e-06. The mean tracks the thermostat target almost exactly, so it moves at roughly the size of the constant change itself; the standard deviation is a fluctuation measure over a chaotic trajectory and moves more.
regenerated.generated_at_commit_subject: fix: use an authoritative Boltzmann constant
regenerated.reason: The velocity initializer's Boltzmann constant was corrected from 8.617343e-5 to the authoritative 8.617333262145177e-5, a relative change of -1.130030e-06. Maxwell-Boltzmann sampling draws sigma = sqrt(k_B T/m) and the rescale that follows targets 2K = dof k_B T, so every initial velocity is scaled by sqrt of that ratio, -5.650e-07 relative. These runs start from randomly sampled velocities, so the whole trajectory moves.
regenerated.still_within_previous_tolerance_note: Every metric stayed inside the case's existing tolerance, so this case would have passed without regeneration. It is regenerated anyway because the stored values had reproduced bit-for-bit and no longer do; leaving them would turn an exact baseline into an approximate one without saying so.
